historical_narrative_note: The window spans COVID and several currency crises. Any account of why a country moved as it did is narrative, is Layer 3, and scores nothing.
no_inferential_statistics: n=117 country-quarters from 6 systems, serially dependent within country and not a sample of any population. Counts and directions only.

D1_F1_failed_because_MY_SPEC_over_assert.what_failed: The locked F1 required every PROV to be non-negative. Eight country-quarters carry a NEGATIVE provisioning figure.
D1_F1_failed_because_MY_SPEC_over_assert.whose_error_this_is: Mine. The spec asserted a range the accounting standard does not impose. The gate is NOT re-scored and F1 stands as failed, because a spec that turns out to be wrong is exactly the case the no-moving-thresholds rule is for. The panel composition -- the part of F1 that tests the DATA -- matched the locked declaration exactly in both panels.
D1_F1_failed_because_MY_SPEC_over_assert.why_the_data_is_fine: A negative provision line is a provision RELEASE -- a write-back of amounts previously reserved. It is ordinary and correct accounting, concentrated in Afghanistan 2018-2023 and one Pakistan quarter.

D2_TWO_SYSTEMS_REPORT_ZERO_EQUITY_BASED_.consequence_for_panel_S: 33 of the 65 country-quarters carry a constant zero, so no median split is possible for those two countries and panel S is effectively Bangladesh and Turkey alone.
D2_TWO_SYSTEMS_REPORT_ZERO_EQUITY_BASED_.finding: Kuwait reports 0.000 equity-based financing income in all 12 of its quarters and Palestine in all 21 of its. Not small -- exactly zero, in every quarter, for six years. Their entire reported financing income is sales-based and lease-based.
D2_TWO_SYSTEMS_REPORT_ZERO_EQUITY_BASED_.why_this_matters_more_than_the_score: The variable on which the risk-sharing claim rests is not merely weak in these systems; on the IFSB's own returns it does not exist. This is a measurement of what is actually booked, made by national supervisors, not a model output.

D3_the_primary_variable_performed_at_the.note: The real loss-absorbing funding share put 3 of 6 countries in the risk-sharing direction. Shuffling that same variable within country put 3.06 of 6 there on average. The measured variable performed at the noise mean, not merely below the 90th-percentile bar. That is a cleaner null than a near miss would have been.

D4_what_this_does_and_does_not_show.does: It shows that at the resolution the IFSB publishes, no such signal is visible, and that in two of four systems the asset-side risk-sharing line is empty. Both are facts a proponent has to answer.
D4_what_this_does_and_does_not_show.does_not: It does NOT show that loss-absorbing funding fails to reduce fragility. Six national aggregates over 25 quarters cannot detect a bank-level mechanism, and provisioning policy is set by supervisors whose rules differ across these six systems.

primary_verdict: F3 MISSED, 3 of 6. F4 MISSED against its own permutation null at the null's mean. On this panel the loss-absorbing funding share carries no visible information about realised non-performing-financing provisioning.
